summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-typescript-nestjs 24.0.5 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: Version 24.0.5 of this ESLint config package ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (v1.3.13) to a tempdir, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a package-local `math_init.js` file. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated bundle (marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`, rotated string-array decoder pattern `WV8StW`, `_0x`-style identifiers) whose contents are opaque and unrelated to any ESLint configuration functionality. The payload is executed exclusively by the fetched alternate runtime, bypassing tools that inspect the Node reachable graph. An ESLint config has no legitimate need to pull a second language runtime at install time or to run an obfuscated executable. The package name and declared repository match the legitimate @ornikar eslint config family, but the preinstall dropper and obfuscated payload are not present upstream, consistent with a namespace/version hijack.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
